literal: By public gossip, sustained is love; that if not present, shrinking-like nature losing.
translation: My love is sustained and thrives because of public gossip; without that gossip, it would lose its nature and fade away.
modern: ஊராரின் அலர் பேச்சால் என் காமம் வளர்கிறது; அந்த அலர் பேச்சு இல்லாவிட்டால், அது தன் தன்மையை இழந்து சுருங்கிப் போய்விடும்.
explanation: In this couplet, the heroine explains how public gossip ('கவ்வை') about her secret love actually acts as a nutrient that keeps her love alive and thriving ('கவ்விது'). She asserts that if there were no such gossip ('அதுவின்றேல்'), her love would lose its vibrant quality ('தன்மை இழந்து') and wither away. The word 'தவ்' is an imitative word representing shrinking or fading. Thus, rather than destroying their bond, the public talk serves to intensify and sustain their mutual passion.
